# conferred by event

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:conferredByEvent`](gmeow-conferredByEvent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/conferredByEvent>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The life event that conferred or changed an appellation — a [`gmeow:LifeEvent`](../classes/gmeow-LifeEvent.md) carrying a [`gmeow:eventType`](gmeow-eventType.md) such as [`gmeow:eventTypeChristening`](../individuals/gmeow-eventTypeChristening.md), [`gmeow:eventTypeNameChange`](../individuals/gmeow-eventTypeNameChange.md), [`gmeow:eventTypeMarriage`](../individuals/gmeow-eventTypeMarriage.md) (a married name), or [`gmeow:eventTypeAdoption`](../individuals/gmeow-eventTypeAdoption.md). Non-functional. The seam joining the names module to the events module's event spine.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md) -> [`gmeow:LifeEvent`](../classes/gmeow-LifeEvent.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:conferredByEvent`](gmeow-conferredByEvent.md) from [`gmeow:Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md) to [`gmeow:LifeEvent`](../classes/gmeow-LifeEvent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md), [`gmeow:LifeEvent`](../classes/gmeow-LifeEvent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to link an appellation to the life event that conferred or changed it — a christening, name change, marriage (a married name), or adoption — joining the names module to the events spine.

### Avoid when

- Avoid carrying the conferral as a free-text note (reference a [`gmeow:LifeEvent`](../classes/gmeow-LifeEvent.md) with its [`gmeow:eventType`](gmeow-eventType.md)) and avoid using it for the name's validity period — carry that on the statement or a [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md).

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:conferredByEvent`](gmeow-conferredByEvent.md) at a [`gmeow:LifeEvent`](../classes/gmeow-LifeEvent.md) carrying the appropriate [`gmeow:eventType`](gmeow-eventType.md); non-functional, so multiple conferring events may coexist for a name's history.

### Examples

- ex:marriedName [`gmeow:conferredByEvent`](gmeow-conferredByEvent.md) ex:wedding.
